content.text: The data show that since July 2018, Zone_F3_Z01's reported temperature jumps from ~22–23.5 °C to a flat ~25.1 °C and stays constant through winter (25.1 °C in 2018-11, 2018-12), while all adjacent zones (F3_Z02, F3_Z03, F3_Z05, F2_Zxx, F4_Zxx) follow a normal seasonal curve (high in summer, low in winter). A real local load change would still modulate seasonally with the building's heating/cooling; a frozen flat reading despite seasonal change is the classic signature of a stuck/faulty sensor.
